releaseNotes:
- Autoscroll now activates ONLY on scrollable empty webpage areas in browsers by default — everywhere else (other apps, links, tabs, toolbars, non-scrollable areas) acts as standard Middle-Click & Middle-Drag
- Added toggle in Settings to switch between Browser-Only (default) and All Apps
- Includes custom macOS AppIcon.icns, 2–10 finger selector, and Thai/English UI
